created: 2026-11-07 05:20 UTC+8, before any synthetic clip was built or scored
purpose: Model-internal synthetic validation set for evalkit: foot contacts and floor are fixed by construction, so the residual-force, RULA/REBA and muscle-load truths are computed, not assumed. It measures the error the pipeline adds (sparse generator joints, scaling and IK, contact from heights, floor parameter, GRF estimation); it does not measure the gap between the Rajagopal model and real people.

truth_model.constructed: RajagopalLaiUhlrich2023 (OpenSim Creator resources), scaled per subject
truth_model.demo_walk: Moco example3DWalking subject_walk_scaled.osim (Rajagopal 2016 with Uhlrich 2022 / Lai 2017 passive forces, welded subtalar / mtp / wrist), its RRA coordinates and measured GRF

demo_excluded.pipelines_rajagopal run: treadmill (grf_run.mot centre of pressure x constant near 1.1 m); a fixed-floor model does not apply

demo_walk.exclude_note: added about 05:45, before scoring: the stride is not periodic, so the cross-fade seams (and the clip ends, one-sided differences) produce accelerations that are construction artifacts (0.19 BW at both seams in the first check); seam +- margin and the first / last margin are E-ambiguous by construction
demo_walk.note: one stride, not periodic; tiles are cross-faded on every coordinate except pelvis_tx, which continues at the stride mean speed; truth is recomputed frame by frame on the tiled motion, so seams that are not realizable are labelled positive by the truth itself

landmark_floor_offset_note: flat-foot height of the toes origin above the floor in the unscaled generic model at its default pose (toes origin y = 0.0115 m with the heel pad on y = 0); scaled with the foot

constructed.note: keyframes in coordinate space with minimum-jerk interpolation; planted feet are fixed by IK on 3 stations per foot body. Pass 1 leaves the 6 pelvis coordinates free and tracks the leg keyframes only weakly so the legs close the chain; each balance pass then prescribes the pelvis rotations and x, z (previous pelvis plus the COM-to-support offset / balance_gain), leaves pelvis_ty free and keeps the weak leg tracking of pass 1 (a weakly tracked pelvis_ty with free legs left the crouch-depth null space uncontrolled: 18 cm pelvis steps); the IK result is low-passed (4th-order zero-phase Butterworth at truth_cutoff_hz, as biomech.write_coordinates) because the per-frame IK noise is amplified by double differentiation in the residual; the subtalar joint unlocked in the synthetic models so each leg has exactly 6 DOF to its foot. Every class except single_leg_unbalanced is balanced so the linear-inverted-pendulum ZMP (COM - h / g * COM acceleration) sits over the keyframed support point. step is a full two-step (right then left foot 0.35 m forward, 0.6 s swings, knees kept at 8 deg so the trailing leg is not at the straight-knee singularity where IK stalled at 9 mm) so that the end pose is the keyframed upright stance; single_leg lifts and lowers over 0.6 s each. foot_slip_max_m amended 0.001 -> 0.005 (the IK closes planted feet to 1-3 mm, well inside the 5 mm contact band). Amended 05:25-05:45 after the first cheap checks (foot slip 1.4-4 cm from competing soft tasks, squat COM off the support) before any scoring; weights and gain: convention, not derived

export.frame: canonical Z-up metres (motion.npz joints, joint_names, fps), like the generators
export.convention: offset and jitter sizes 约定，未经推演 (stand in for the landmark mismatch between a generator skeleton and the Rajagopal joint centres)
export.seed: crc32 of the clip id, one independent landmark-offset / jitter / floor-shift draw per clip. Amended before any scoring: the first build used subject_seed*1000+defect_index, which gave clips of different bases with the same defect index the same draw (correlated noise; the dev controls had 2 draws in total); inputs were re-exported from the unchanged truth

defect_definitions.float / penetrate: pelvis_ty +- size (window: raised-cosine ramp over the middle third, 0.1 s edges); truth recomputed on the shifted motion
defect_definitions.lean_deg: lumbar_extension - size (forward flexion) over the middle third, feet unchanged
defect_definitions.time_compression: the same frames played size times faster
defect_definitions.bone_stretch: export only: right humerus and forearm lengthened by the factor over the middle third (no body can produce these joints)
defect_definitions.slide_m_s: constructed classes only: the planted right foot target moves forward at size m/s during the middle third, re-solved by IK (stays on the floor)

truth.contact_rule: a landmark (calcn / toes origin) is in contact when the construction (planted interval) or the force plate (demo, > 20 N) says so and its elevation above its flat-foot height is <= the lower band value; above the upper value it is off the floor; between: ambiguous frame
truth.realizability: biomech.estimate_grf on the true contact landmarks projected to the floor (friction 0.8, sole points of biomech.SOLE)
truth.e_label: positive: lowest elevation below the penetration upper value, or truth residual >= 0.10 BW; negative: no landmark below the penetration lower value and residual <= 0.02 BW; otherwise ambiguous (excluded from the error rates, share reported)
truth.measurable_label: bone_stretch frames with stretch >= 0.1 are positive for the measurability judgment; stretch <= 0.02 negative
truth.ergo_label: evalkit.ergo on the true coordinates, true contact and the noise-free exported joints
truth.muscle: static optimization (biomech.static_optimization) on the true coordinates and the truth GRF; whole-body effort = mean over frames of the sum of squared activations
truth.convention: band edges 约定，未经推演

splits.rule: tune only on dev; freeze (commit hash) before the single held-out run

muscle_subset: controls of every base and subject (truth and tool static optimization)
